LanguageData.HE_Roma_Gladius.label: legion gladius
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Gladius.description: The short sword of the legions, forged with a broad stabbing point. Light and quick, it is made to strike from behind a shield wall.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Gladius.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Gladius.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Gladius.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Pilum.label: pilum
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Pilum.description: A heavy javelin with a long soft-iron shank. In close fighting it is a spear whose point bends inside shields and armor and does not let go.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Pilum.tools.0.label: shaft
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Pilum.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Manuballista.label: manuballista
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Manuballista.description: A torsion crossbow small enough for one soldier. It is slow to wind but its iron bolt hits like a thrown pilum.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Manuballista.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Carbine.label: legion carbine
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Carbine.description: A short breech-loading carbine with a red-lacquered stock and a brass eagle on the lock plate. It loads fast and handles well at close range.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Carbine.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Carbine.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Spatha.label: spatha
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Spatha.description: The long sword of the cavalry and of the later legions. Longer than the gladius, it cuts well from horseback and still has a good point.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Spatha.tools.0.label: pommel
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Spatha.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Spatha.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Arquebus.label: Roman arquebus
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Arquebus.description: A matchlock arquebus with a red-lacquered stock and a brass eagle on the lock. The legions learned powder late and drilled it hard: it is the steadiest of the powder arms up close.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Arquebus.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Arquebus.tools.1.label: barrel
